crossRefs.note: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and…
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and…
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
“Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there…
But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
“This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

translations.web: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
translations.bsb: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
translations.kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
translations.asv: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.
